skill_name: Generate a pizza recipe for 2 people.
workflow: This pizza recipe serves 2 people. Preheat oven to 450 degrees F. In a large bowl, combine 1 cup of flour and 1/2 teaspoon of salt. Stir in 1/2 cup of warm water and 1 teaspoon of olive oil until the dough forms a ball. Knead the dough on a lightly floured surface for 5 minutes. Divide the dough into two equal parts and place them on a greased baking sheet. Spread the pizza sauce and sprinkle with your favorite toppings.
